name: Sakuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakuma town emblem in green: a stylised device of a star-like top above a triangle, like the character 佐.
history: Flag of the former town of Sakuma in Shizuoka Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-01.

features.role: Sakuma town emblem — a stylised device of a star-like top above a triangle, like the character 佐
